title: Add structured digest-anchor attachments to mailbox messages
outcome: Heavy mailbox coordination repeatedly carries frozen path/digest anchors in prose, forcing recipients to parse and transcribe security/governance inputs by hand. Add an optional immutable structured attachment payload for typed anchor lists (at minimum path plus digest, with room for explicitly typed key/value metadata) alongside the exact body. Preserve it transactionally, include it in authorized exact/range reads, surface it in the read-only UI, and keep idempotency comparisons stable. This must not turn arbitrary attachments into executable instructions.
acceptance: Send/read/restart round trips preserve structured anchors exactly; malformed or oversized attachments are rejected deterministically; idempotent retries compare attachment content; authorization matches message-body access; UI and MCP/API tests demonstrate machine-readable verification without prose parsing.
